build.energy_regen_target: not published; high — Prydwen notes she is very energy-hungry and needs ER investment plus energy-feeding teammates to fund her 125-energy Liberation
build.fast_path: Fast path: Lustrous Razor (Discord as the 4-star rotation pick) + 5-piece Moonlit Clouds in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, with Impermanence Heron in the main slot. Run Crit Rate or Crit DMG on the 4-cost, Electro DMG (or Energy Regen) on the 3-costs, and ATK% on the 1-costs. Her job is feeding the next Resonator a 38% Resonance Skill DMG Outro, so Concerto speed and Liberation uptime matter as much as her own damage.

ranked_weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
ranked_weapons.note: Game8's #1 pick. Energy Regen plus stacking Resonance Liberation DMG lets her cast Liberation every rotation. It is a standard-banner 5-star.

ranked_weapons.name: Ages of Harvest
ranked_weapons.note: Prydwen's top damage pick: 12% Attribute DMG and 24% Resonance Skill DMG on Intro and Skill casts. It is Jinhsi's signature, not hers.

ranked_weapons.name: Verdant Summit
ranked_weapons.note: Jiyan's signature. A big Crit DMG stat, plus Heavy Attack DMG after skills. Strong on her Basic Attack-focused kit.

ranked_weapons.name: Discord
ranked_weapons.note: The best 4-star for rotations. It restores Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill, which speeds up her Outro.

ranked_weapons.name: Waning Redshift
ranked_weapons.note: An event 4-star. It grants Resonance Energy and ATK on Resonance Skill cast. The free last resort is Broadblade of Voyager.

stat_priorities.note: Balance Crit Rate and Crit DMG. Her Forte damage scales mostly off Basic Attack DMG.
Electro DMG is the standard pick. Swap a 3-cost to Energy Regen if her Liberation uptime suffers.

profile.role_note: An Electro Hybrid buffer with a dual-stance kit that switches between ranged and melee. Her Outro grants the next Resonator 38% Resonance Skill DMG for 10s. That makes her a natural partner for Skill-scaling carries like Hsin and Changli.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Lumi is a handy 4-star Hybrid. She hands carries who scale with Resonance Skill DMG a 38% damage boost. She is a niche pick, but real value if you run Hsin or Changli. She is not a pull priority on her own.
